title: Nueces County OEM: Sitrep Closes 23:00, Then Dr. Anil Chaudhary on the ICU Trade-Off

fields.systemName: Recorded Line - Hospital Command Center, Ext. 4520 (Speakerphone)

caller.name: Nueces County OEM Duty Officer
caller.label: Nueces County Office of Emergency Management

transcript.speaker: OEM Duty Officer
transcript.text: Mariner Bay, this is the Nueces County OEM duty desk. Is this command?

transcript.speaker: OEM Duty Officer
transcript.text: Okay. The state situation report closes at 23:00 tonight. I need your shelter-or-evacuate status and your patient numbers before then. I mean a status, not 'still deciding.'

transcript.speaker: OEM Duty Officer
transcript.text: Road picture. TxDOT expects to close the causeways and the US 181 bridge when tropical-storm winds arrive, around noon tomorrow. NWS Corpus Christi says the I-37 low points near the Nueces River could flood before that. So don't plan on ground runs tomorrow morning.

transcript.speaker: OEM Duty Officer
transcript.text: Who's going to call me back with your status, and at what time?

transcript.speaker: Dr. Anil Chaudhary
transcript.text: Before you hang up, this is Dr. Anil Chaudhary, critical care. You need to hear this too. Of my 6 vented ICU patients, 4 can handle a five-and-a-half-hour ground ride. Bed 3-07 is on three pressors. Bed 3-14 is proned. Neither of them goes anywhere.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Anil Chaudhary
transcript.text: ICU charge, I need to know which of the 19 can move, and how many of them are on contact isolation. Beds 3-11 and 3-18 are on contact precautions with different organisms. They can't share a rig and they can't share a room on the other end.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Anil Chaudhary
transcript.text: Here's the trade. If we evacuate, vented patients ride five and a half hours on 5 ground units and 2 helicopter missions, into 8 receiving beds, total. If we shelter, I'm running 1:3 on landfall night with the ED, imaging and the main pharmacy on a ground floor that sits under a 4-to-6-foot surge forecast. Neither one is free.

transcript.speaker: OEM Duty Officer
transcript.text: Copy all. I'll put Mariner Bay down as pending. But I need your status and your numbers, transferring and sheltering, on this line before 23:00. What do you want me to tell the state right now?

transcript.speaker: OEM Duty Officer
transcript.text: Understood. OEM duty desk standing by.

voiceStyles.OEM Duty Officer: Man in his 50s, calm and clipped, county EOC phones ringing in the background, in a hurry but polite
voiceStyles.Dr. Anil Chaudhary: Physician in her 40s, standing next to the speakerphone, tired, blunt and precise, talks fast with the numbers

instructorNote: This is the main decision point. The IC should decide with the CNO, the Medical Director, the Facilities Director and the county between a partial horizontal evacuation of transport-tolerant patients within the 8 confirmed beds and shelter in place with Vertical Evacuation Phase 1 by 06:00. The decision goes on record with reasons by 00:00 and is reported to OEM before 23:00. Check that the ICU Charge Nurse produces a list of who can move (excluding 3-07 and 3-14) and plans a separate rig and receiving room for each of isolation patients 3-11 and 3-18.
